result.summary: The street features a continuous sidewalk along a residential row-house frontage with on-street parallel parking. There is a lack of dedicated pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crossings, traffic calming measures, or a buffer between the walkway and the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also encouraging slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint and signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffering
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Marked High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the concrete sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to create a physical buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffering
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the distance between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Clear Walkway Obstructions
interventions.description: Enforce regulations to keep the sidewalk clear of large stored items or debris to maintain a continuous accessible path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions or Parklets
interventions.description: Install curb extensions or a furniture zone to create a buffer between the sidewalk and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing and Maintenance
interventions.description: Remove the tires and debris from the sidewalk to restore the full effective width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically oriented towards the sidewalk to improve safety and security at night.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If a trolley stop is present, install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Tactile Delineation for Tracks
interventions.description: Use tactile paving or distinct color/texture changes to clearly separate the tram track zone from the primary pedestrian walking path.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate or consolidate utility boxes and poles to the furniture zone or underground to provide a clear, unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Remove Sidewalk Obstructions
interventions.description: Clear the walkway of the large metal structure to restore pedestrian access and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Level the sidewalk using root-friendly methods such as structural soil or flexible porous pavement to eliminate trip hazards.

interventions.title: Tree Pit Expansion
interventions.description: Enlarge the tree pit to provide more space for root growth and reduce future pavement damage.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to provide more clear walking space, especially given the constraint of the fence.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk with High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with signage to provide a designated and safer location for pedestrians to cross the street.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also encouraging slower driving speeds.
